title: ECO-TECH CLUB ORIENTATION 2026
description: Innovate for Campus. Implement for Impact. Celebrating National Science Day, we honor the spirit of innovation inspired by Sir C.V. Raman. Join us to build practical solutions for campus challenges and turn scientific ideas into sustainable innovations.
longDescription:
Are you ready to build solutions that matter? Join the Eco-Tech Club Orientation and discover how your ideas can solve real challenges at Presidency University.

🔬 Work on live campus problems
⚙️ Develop practical tech solutions
🌱 Turn scientific ideas into sustainable innovations
🏆 Get mentorship, recognition & growth opportunities
